question: Jack Nicholson took a reduced $6 million fee to play the Joker in 1989's Batman. Roughly what did the role earn him?
answer: Over $50 million, by most estimates; some reach $90 million. Nicholson swapped a higher fee for a share of the gross takings and of merchandise bearing the Joker, and the film took over $400 million worldwide. The small figure was only the floor of the deal. Every Joker T-shirt sold paid him a little more.
move: Price a deal by its share of the upside, not by its headline sum.
ask: When I judge a deal, do I look at the headline sum or my share of the upside?
trap: Letting the $6 million fee set the scale for the whole payday.
